scope: Incremental review: complete Rust hash source and embedded tests, root and crate README/manifests, benchmark; three image fixtures visually inspected. Python bridge/reference/tests, workflows, license and generated locks remain for later review.

upstream_tests.initial_offline_attempt: Dependency resolution failed because pyo3 index entry was absent; online locked retry succeeded.

controls.method: Added standalone example calls unchanged public API; catch_unwind classifies panic without changing library. No native pHash or ASAN.

findings: No minimum-dimension validation before pixel summation/interpolation; malformed/small dimensions panic rather than return typed Error. Confirmed via public API.
test_distance only prints similarities: passing status does not assert near/far ordering or a retrieval threshold.
Criterion from_image benchmark invokes from_image_path per iteration, including file read and decode; no timings executed or optimization accepted.
144-byte gradient descriptor and normalized distance scores are candidate evidence, not proof of byte equality or calibrated probability.
No production code copied or altered. Python and packaging validation remain open.
